lines.en: I know you can't stand to be in the same room as me,
so I just thought I'd try and apologize over the phone.
Look, I never should've kissed your girlfriend, and I'm...
Hey, hey, hey! This is 92.3 WXRK Zero.
I'm calling for the $1,000 Daily Challenge.
- All right! - What is the name of...
Your roommate who is very, very sorry and would do anything...
